issues.issue: Trial name claims 'Study 1 (BIA-2093-301)' but the cited table row is from a different document and the quote 'BIA-2093-301...' is a stitched/tab-delimited OCR fragment; the mapping of Study 1 = 301 is reasonable but the dose columns (400/800/1200) in the N and result rows are not explicitly labeled, risking mis-assignment of the 800 mg column.

The cited row 'N\t95\t88\t87' is unlabeled; mapping these to placebo/800mg/1200mg is an inference not supported by the quote, and Studies 1-2 also had a 400mg arm, so the column assignment may be wrong.
Cited row 'N\t99\t87\t81' is unlabeled; assigning columns to placebo/800/1200 (omitting the 400mg arm present in Study 2's design) is unsupported by the quote.
Result assigns LS-mean values 6.6/5.0/4.3 to placebo/800/1200 from an unlabeled stitched quote '(p-value)\t6.6\t5.0...'; the dose-to-column mapping is inferred and not stated in the quote.
Result assigns 8.6/6.2/6.6 to placebo/800/1200 from an unlabeled stitched quote; dose-to-column mapping is inferred, not verbatim-supported.
Result assigns 7.9/6.5/6.0 to placebo/800/1200 from an unlabeled stitched quote; dose mapping inferred, not stated.

Design text merges three separate quotes (dose comparison, 'only new pivotal study', and DE-diary description) into one composite; acceptable since each phrase has its own citation, but it blends review-narrative detail beyond a clean design description.

value=false is correctly supported here (the review explicitly states a prior CR letter on 4-30-10), so this is appropriate and consistent with crl_history; noted only to confirm it is not a false flag.

Basis text asserts 'reviewed under Priority review (PDUFA date 11/8/13)' but the only cited quote is 'Review Priority: Priority'; the PDUFA date 11/8/13 is not in this field's citation (it appears only in the receipt_date citation).

Summary states the resubmission 'added a new controlled Study 304 and updated analyses of Studies 301 and 302', but study IDs 301/302 are not present in any summary citation quote (uncited numbers 301/302).
Flagged numbers '800' and '1200' throughout n/result fields are dose labels and are false positives per the dose-exclusion rule.
Flagged number '4' ('maintained...for four weeks') is supported by the citation ('maintained at this dose for four weeks'); false positive.
